card.text: Explore the smaller inner moon of 2001 SN263 through its archived radar shape.

introduction.text: 2001 SN263 Gamma is the smaller, inner moon of the triple asteroid system 2001 SN263. Published radar shape of the smaller, inner moon. Fine terrain and visible-light color are unresolved; the grid marks missing imagery. The archive includes weakly observed model regions. The model assumes the primary’s spin pole for this moon. Rotational phase is illustrative. Orbital placement is approximate context extrapolated from the 2008 mutual-orbit fit. Current phase and long-term three-body evolution are not measured.
